mechanism: Both agents lower blood pressure through different mechanisms (ACE inhibition and beta-blockade); ophthalmic timolol undergoes systemic absorption and can cause additive hypotensive effects, particularly in elderly patients or those with renal impairment.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; adjust enalapril dose if hypotension develops; counsel patient on timolol application technique to minimize systemic absorption (punctal occlusion, eye closure for 2-3 minutes post-instillation).
